assertions.assertion: Calls AddLocalApiAuthentication() to set up local API authentication

assertions.rationale: Uses IdentityServerConstants.LocalApi.PolicyName in the policy and RequireAuthorization.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that clients must include 'IdentityServerApi' in their AllowedScopes
assertions.rationale: Only says to register an IdentityServerApi ApiScope and 'allow clients to request it'; it never mentions AllowedScopes explicitly.

assertions.assertion: Warns that local API authentication only works when the API is co-hosted with IdentityServer, not for separate API hosts
assertions.rationale: Never warns that local API authentication works only when co-hosted with IdentityServer and not for separate API hosts.
